headline: Man-Eater Bug
title: Man-Eater Bug Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Man-Eater Bug. What is it? It is a Level two EARTH Insect Flip monster. What does it do? When it is flipped face-up, target one monster on the field and destroy it. How do you use it? Set it face-down. When your opponent attacks it, or when you flip it yourself, destroy their strongest monster. Book of Moon can turn it face-down again for another use. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
